curb_weight_kg.notes: EV Specifications: about 4,369.56 lb (1,982 kg); cars.com and iSeeCars show 4,369 lb for US Platinum+ (x0.45359 = 1,982). EV Specifications does not state its source; the cars.com/iSeeCars figures were not opened by the fact-checker.

consumption_highway_wh_per_km.notes: Test: 70 mph (112.7 km/h) steady, ~3.3 °C (38 °F) avg, dry not stated, 19-inch alloy wheels, battery-side vs wall-side not stated by the article (Out of Spec normally reads the car display) | Out of Spec Reviews test of a 2026 Platinum+ (75 kWh, 214 hp, same as ours), reported by InsideEVs: 215 mi at constant 70 mph until power was limited, averaged 2.8 mi/kWh. Conversion: 1000 / (2.8 x 1.609344) = 221.9 Wh/km. Cold ambient, so higher than a mild-weather figure. Other tests seen, not recorded: MotorTrend 70 mph 243 mi; Consumer Reports SV+ 292 mi at 70 mph. | NOT FOR CALIBRATION: cold test (about 3 °C); exclude from the highway-factor fit (item 3.7).
